correctness.rationale: The zonotope maximal-minor volume identities for fixed reduced 5×7 incidence matrix and orthogonal u,v yield V,P,Q,W polynomial sums. Independent complete exact enumeration of all 21/35/35/35 minors verifies V=2abc^2(3a+3b+2c), P=12abc^2, Q=cH, W=2c(8ab+3ac+3bc), VW-PQ=16a^2b^2c^4. Consequently R=1+4abc/(3H)>1 throughout positive weights; writing s=a+b and ab<=s^2/4 strictly maximizes at a=b; with t=c/a, R-1=t/[3(t+2)^2], whose unique maximum 1/24 occurs at t=2.
residual_risks: Precisely specified 5-dimensional reduced incidence coordinates, orthogonal fixed u,v, three positive path-constant edge weights. Not all zonotopes, all projections, zero-edge degenerations, affine-equivalent coordinate metrics, or all individual edge weights.
